name: Qwen3.8-27B
blurb: 64 layers, but only 16 of them are attention. The other 48 are GatedDeltaNet — a linear-attention recurrence with constant state, no KV cache and no quadratic term. Architecturally identical to Qwen3.5-27B; it reuses Qwen3-VL's ViT with deepstack switched off.
shape_note: 64 layers = 48 linear + 16 full, every 4th full · hidden 5120 · head_dim 256 · 24 Q / 4 KV heads · linear: 16 key heads × 128, 48 value heads × 128 · vocab 248320 · mRoPE [11,11,10] θ=1e7, partial 0.25.
